column3: “Took” is rendered “took up.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The house of the tombs” is rendered “the place of … tombs.”
“On what is this you are requesting” is rendered “What would you request.”
“If it is good on the king” is rendered “If it please the king,” and “if your servant is good before you” as “if your servant has found favor before you.”
“Queen-consort” is rendered “queen,” and “a time” as “a definite time.”
NASB supplies “the provinces.”
“The citadel which belongs to the house” is rendered “the fortress which is by the temple.” “According to the hand” is rendered “because the … hand.”
“Commanders” is rendered “officers”; NASB supplies “the provinces.”
“Tobiah the servant” is rendered “Tobiah the … official,” and “displeasing with great displeasure” as “very displeasing.” “Good” is rendered “welfare.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Heart” is rendered “mind.”
“The Spring of the Dragons” is rendered “the Dragon's Well,” and “the gate of the dung” as “the Refuse Gate.” “Examining” is rendered “inspecting.”
“The animal” is rendered “my mount,” and NASB omits “under me.”
“The wadi” is rendered “the ravine”; “turned back and went in” is rendered “entered … again.”
“Was doing” is rendered “had done,” and “until thus” as “as yet.”
“The trouble” is rendered “the bad situation.”
“That it was good on me” is rendered “had been favorable to me.” “Strengthened their hands for the good” is rendered “put their hands to the good work.”
“Tobiah the servant” is rendered “Tobiah the … official.”
“Brought back word” is rendered “answered”; NASB supplies “therefore,” and “rebuild” is rendered “build.”
